html:
Remark. Scope, structural value, and open ribbon-closure derivation of the chirality factor

Remark (Scope of derivation). This proposition fully derives the amphichiral case. For chiral knots, the raw algebra pairing returns 1; the 1+h factor requires a complete categorical derivation tracking the braided ribbon-category closure. The twist \varTheta_X encodes the writhe, and its interaction with the Frobenius pairing drives the first-order chiral contribution.
